illustrative_impact.semantics: Illustrative deficit sizing only: assumes control whole-window TPS during gaps/minute. Not measured lost transactions, not removal or a corrected benchmark.

limitations: All original measured intervals remain included; this does not establish a prepared-key causal regression or an adjusted TPS result.
Host /proc data describe the desktop host, not the Docker VM/container cgroups. Memory/IO pressure correlation is not an attribution to a specific process or code path.

Actor max_execute is wall residency and can contain descheduling/page-fault delays; it is not exclusive CPU. Some saved OverlayImpl max_delay values are implausible (~4.85e9 seconds) and must not be interpreted.
Generator canonical discovery rate measures observer progress, not production; independently saved consensus accepted-block gaps establish the producer stall.
INFO validator scheduling log was empty at configured verbosity; no kernel/page-fault/election reason log proves an underlying cause.
Interior admission deltas use slightly different sampled boundaries and are not exact whole-window populations.

interpretation.observed: Two synchronous validator progress stalls with plentiful ready generator work, admission timeouts and AIMD window reductions dominate much of the observed throughput deficit.
